fusions.name: Crescent Pass
fusions.desc: Draws the tines round in a curve, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Late Harvest
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Binding the Sheaf
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Swathe
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
